ValidationRule.description: Requires Customer Need and Purchase Timeframe be entered and Qualification Outcome be 'Meets Criteria' when Status is Qualified.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Qualified"), OR( ISBLANK(Customer_Need__c), ISPICKVAL(Purchase_Timeframe__c, ""), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Qualification_Outcome__c, "Meets Criteria")) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When Status is Qualified, Customer Need and Purchase Timeframe must be completed, and Qualification Outcome must be 'Meets Criteria'.
